headline: No votes taken; the meeting discussed rent control enforcement changes, inclusionary zoning, and a Bloomberg housing offer.
summary: Staff presented the third quarter rent control report. Members reviewed proposed changes to the rent control ordinance but took no vote. They also discussed inclusionary zoning and a possible Bloomberg housing program, with no action taken.
discussion: Rent control ordinance changes: Members reviewed proposed edits, including how housing services and dwelling units are defined. The housing services question was left open, and no vote was taken.
Base rent after exemption: Members said the rules for base rent after a unit is vacant or exempt are unclear. Corporation counsel said the current law is enforceable and can be clarified later.
Inclusionary zoning review: Speakers urged bringing in outside housing policy experts and cited Portland's 2020 policy results. A third workshop is planned for November.

Bloomberg housing program: The mayor said the program would offer up to $750,000 in technical assistance over two years. Staff will review the materials, and members asked for a council-level workshop before any sign-up.
